notes: Environment preconditions that are broken today. Each gate names one root cause and the error signature that identifies it in a run. Failures matching a signature are reported as blocked, so one backend defect does not read as dozens of independent coverage regressions. Remove a gate once its defect is fixed and the signature stops matching.

gates.title: A client's programs cannot be listed
gates.meaning: The suite resolves its test client by capability, which starts with this call, so almost every client-scoped check stops before it asserts anything. Skills Programs, Analyze Data, Behavior Support, Sessions and the client-workspace UI all depend on it.
gates.rootCause: Npgsql 42703: column l.legacy_id does not exist — the deployed query is ahead of the dev2 schema.
gates.signature: legacy_id does not exist|programs for client \d+ returned 500|clients/\d+/programs[\s\S]{0,160}HTTP 500

gates.title: The program library catalogue cannot be read
gates.meaning: The organisation-wide template catalogue is unavailable, so the library API checks and the Program Library administration page cannot load their rows.
gates.rootCause: HTTP 500 from the gateway with a text/plain body; same deploy as DEF-7.
gates.signature: clinical/v1/program-library[\s\S]{0,160}HTTP 500|Program Library admin should finish loading|catalog should include a standard/core program

gates.title: Behavior plans cannot be listed
gates.meaning: Behavior Support cannot show a client's plans. The scenarios that assert the correct behaviour are tagged @bug and excluded from the default run, so this gate is usually invisible there.
gates.rootCause: HTTP 500 for every client on dev2.
